proposals.title: ADVISORY VOTE ON ADOPTION OF ANTIBIOTICS POLICY
proposals.proponent: The Congregation of the Benedictine Sisters of Boerne, Texas ("BSBT")
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an enterprise-wide policy to phase out medically-important antibiotics for disease prevention in beef and pork supply chains, with sourcing targets, timelines, metrics and third-party verification.
proposals.evidence: Our Board unanimously recommends that you vote AGAINST Proposal 6.

proposals.title: ADVISORY VOTE ON WORLDWIDE SWITCH TO CAGE-FREE EGGS
proposals.topic_summary: Requests measurable targets for switching to cage-free eggs worldwide and regular reporting of progress toward those targets.
proposals.evidence: Our Board unanimously recommends that you vote "AGAINST" Proposal 7.

proposals.title: ADVISORY VOTE ON POULTRY WELFARE DISCLOSURE
proposals.proponent: The Humane Society of the United States ("HSUS")
proposals.topic_summary: Requests disclosure of McDonald's 15 key welfare indicators for broiler chickens and explanation of how each is used to measure and improve animal welfare.
proposals.evidence: Our Board unanimously recommends that you vote "AGAINST" Proposal 8.

proposals.title: ADVISORY VOTE ON CONGRUENCY ANALYSIS ON HUMAN RIGHTS
proposals.proponent: The National Legal and Policy Center ("NLPC")
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report analyzing congruency between the company's human rights policy positions and its actions, especially in conflict zones or under oppressive regimes, by March 31, 2025.
proposals.evidence: Our Board unanimously recommends that you vote "AGAINST" Proposal 9.

proposals.title: Advisory Vote on corporate Giving Disclosure
proposals.proponent: The National Center for Public Policy Research ("NCPPR")
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the Board list on the company website recipients of material donations, optimally all recipients of $5,000 or more, excluding employee matching gifts.
proposals.evidence: Our Board unanimously recommends that you vote AGAINST Proposal 10.

proposals.title: Advisory Vote on Annual Report on Global Political Influence
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual transparency report disclosing company political, lobbying and charitable policy-related expenditures and activities outside the United States, including recipients, amounts and rationale.
proposals.evidence: Our Board unanimously recommends that you vote "AGAINST" Proposal 11.
